title: OpenCode Connect screen and model picker
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; A-16 connection half works against the local service and against an unreachable service
notes: App half of the assistant connection per ADR 0011, using the T-0251 client crate. Serves the connection half of acceptance item A-16 (AI Assistant through OpenCode) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Connect screen that discovers the local OpenCode service or accepts a paired remote URL and password, lists providers and models from the service, defaults to `opencode-go/hy4-flash-free`, lets the user change and remembers the choice, disconnects, and shows a real connection status. Never displays or logs the service password. Calls the T-0251 API and does not change its semantics. Feature-matrix rows stay as the library leaves them until this task verifies them.
